description: Header file defining the MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession class, which implements a QUIC client session encapsulated within MASQUE, supporting IP and packet processing, connection management, and encapsulation capsules.

classes.name: MasqueEncapsulatedClientSession
classes.description: A QUIC client session encapsulated within MASQUE, supporting IP address management and packet processing.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an encapsulated QUIC packet received from the server.

methods.name: CloseConnection
methods.description: Closes the QUIC connection with a specified error and details.

methods.name: ProcessIpPacket
methods.description: Processes an IP packet received for the session.

methods.name: CloseIpSession
methods.description: Closes the IP session with provided details.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when the connection is closed.
